title: Clinical Research of Human Retinal Pigment Epithelial (HuRPE) Cell Injection on Atrophy of High Myopia Macular Area
brief_summary: To evaluate the safety and tolerability of human retinal pigment epithelial (HuRPE) cell injection subretinal transplantation for atrophy of high myopia macular area, and to explore the maximum tolerated dose (MTD).
